info.name: UI Judo Club Attendance & Outreach API
info.description:
API collection for the University of Ibadan Judo Club Attendance and Member Outreach System.

### Authentication
Endpoints marked with 🔒 require an active session cookie (`uijudo.sid`).
Log in via Google OAuth (`/api/auth/google`) or send the session cookie with your requests.

request.description: Returns basic service health status, environment mode, and uptime.

exec: body { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; background: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; min-height: 85vh; margin: 0; padding: 20px; }
.card { background: #1e293b; padding: 36px 32px; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); text-align: center; max-width: 520px; border: 1px solid #334155; }

.btn { display: inline-block; margin-top: 18px; background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 15px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.3); }
.info { margin-top: 24px; background: #0f172a; padding: 14px; border-radius: 6px; text-align: left; font-size: 12px; color: #cbd5e1; border: 1px solid #334155; }
Google authentication requires interactive consent in your web browser.
🌐 Authenticate in Browser
1. Click the button above to launch Google login in your browser.
2. Log in with an authorized email (e.g., coach@uijudo.club).
3. Google redirects to /api/auth/google/callback and sets your session cookie.
4. Return to Postman to execute protected endpoints!
console.log('Popup blocked, click the button manually.');

request.description: Initiates Google OAuth 2.0 flow. In Postman, click Send and inspect the 'Visualize' tab to open Google login in your system browser, or click the direct link.

request.description: Returns detailed attendance analytics (7/30/60/90 days counts, last/prev attendance dates, frequency, trend) and activity status (ACTIVE, RECENTLY_INACTIVE, INACTIVE, LONG_TERM_INACTIVE, NEVER_ATTENDED).

Records training attendance for a member in the dedicated Google Sheets tab.

- Duplicate check: Same member + date + session rejects with 409 Conflict unless `isCorrection: true`.
- `recordedBy` is automatically populated from the authenticated session user.
